# CHILLFILTR®

> CHILLFILTR® is an independent music blog and radio that amplifies independent voices in popular music and modern literature. Its taste falls roughly into three categories: indie rock, folk-roots-soul, and electro pop. It's run by Krister Axel in Ashland, Oregon, whose KSKQ radio show The Weekly Catch draws on its songs.

## Pages

- [Home](https://chillfiltr.com/): the latest posts, filterable by topic (music, prose, personal, and lifestyle).
- [Radio](https://chillfiltr.com/pages/radio): CHILLFILTR® Radio, a live example of the site's taste.
- [Archive](https://chillfiltr.com/pages/archive): older posts.
- [Search](https://chillfiltr.com/pages/search): search the posts.
- [Tags](https://chillfiltr.com/tag) and [authors](https://chillfiltr.com/authors): posts grouped by tag and writer.
- [Submit your music](https://chillfiltr.com/submit): send songs for review, for a small listening fee.
- [About](https://chillfiltr.com/pages/about): the site and its founder.
- [Contact](https://chillfiltr.com/pages/contact) and [support the site](https://chillfiltr.com/pages/support).

Posts live at `/post/<slug>`, tags at `/tag/<slug>`, authors at `/author/<slug>`, and playlists at `/playlist/<slug>`.
